log.emptyHint: No readings yet — click Log Reading to record
log.tipLogReading: Log Reading Snapshot current experiment state: RF frequency, field, Vm (target & healthy), selectivity, temperature, disruption ratios. Auto-logged on lysis events.
log.tipExportCsv: Export CSV Download all log entries. Columns: #, time, freq (kHz), field (V/cm), T-Vm (mV), H-Vm (mV), selectivity, event type.
log.tipClearLog: Clear Log Remove all readings from this session. This action cannot be undone.
log.tipThNumber: # — Entry Index Sequential reading number (newest first).
log.tipThTime: Time — Timestamp Local time (HH:MM:SS) when the reading was logged.
log.tipThFreq: Freq — RF Frequency Broadcast frequency at time of reading. Below fc → quasi-DC, Vm at maximum. Above fc → Schwan roll-off reduces Vm.
log.tipThField: Field — Applied Electric Field Field intensity at time of reading. Vm scales linearly with E (Schwan eq.).
log.tipThTargetVm: T-Vm — Target Transmembrane Potential Peak voltage across target cell membrane via Schwan equation. Higher → more disruption.
log.tipThHealthyVm: H-Vm — Healthy Transmembrane Potential Peak voltage across healthy reference membrane. Keep below 50% of threshold for safe operation.
log.tipThSel: Sel× — Vm Selectivity Ratio T-Vm / H-Vm — raw membrane potential ratio. ≥ {strong}× Strong therapeutic window {marginal}–{strong}× Marginal window < {marginal}× Non-selective
log.tipThEvent: Event Type manual — snapshot triggered by user lysis — membrane disrupted (auto-logged)
log.tipCellLysis: ⚡ Lysis event Target membrane irreversibly disrupted. Auto-logged when lysis countdown completed.
log.tipCellManual:
Manual snapshot
Logged by user at this timestamp.
log.tipDose: Cumulative Specific Energy Dose [J/kg] Running integral of the specific absorption rate (SAR) over the session: Dose = ∫ SAR × dc × dt SAR = σ_i · α² · E² · wf / ρ (W/kg) α = 3σ_e / (2σ_e + σ_i) (internal field factor) wf = 0.5 (CW) · 1.0 (pulsed) Dose accumulates only when the field is active. ICNIRP 2020 occupational whole-body limit: 0.4 W/kg SAR. This display tracks target-cell dose — not whole-body average. Reset when the log is cleared.
